ينملس (form VII)
# يَنْمَلِسُ (yanmalisu) /jan.ma.li.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# يَنْمَلِسَ (yanmalisa) /jan.ma.li.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# يَنْمَلِسْ (yanmalis) /jan.ma.lis/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
